_note: Canvas presets. Screen sizes are pixels at 1x. Print sizes are millimetres; the renderer lays them out in CSS px at 96 dpi and exports PNG at 300 dpi plus a vector PDF. safe = inset for text as a fraction of the short side (screen) or millimetres (print). min_px = smallest allowed font size in CSS px for body text and captions. bleed_mm adds a print bleed on every side: the PNG/PDF are trim size plus bleed, keep text inside safe.
